The '''Dwarven Mine''' is a large mine ran by [[dwarves]] located beneath [[Asgarnia]]. It contains a variety of [[ore]]s and can be accessed from the entrance south of [[Ice Mountain]] or from the two entrances located in [[Falador]]. The Dwarven Mine also connects to both the [[Mining Guild]] and the [[Motherlode Mine]], which are located at the southern end of the mine.

At the southern end of the mine, there is a severe infestation of [[scorpion]]s and [[King Scorpion]]s that will trouble those with lower [[combat level]]s. You need a combat level of 65 in order to be left alone by the King Scorpions. North of the scorpions is an [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] ([[Narrow crevice (Dwarven Mine)|narrow crevice]] in the wall) requiring level 42 Agility. The Mining Guild can be found in the southern part of the mine, requiring 60 Mining to access. The [[Cave (Dwarven Mine)|entrance]] to the [[Motherlode Mine]] can be found in the south-eastern section of the Dwarven Mine marked by a dungeon [[icon]] ([[File:Dungeon icon.png]]). To make use of the Motherlode Mine, players require a minimum of 30 Mining, with 57 Mining required to access the upper level.

==Transportation==
{{Map|name=Dwarven Mine|x=3018|y=3450|caption=The main entrance to the Dwarven Mine|align=left|mtype=pin|icon=redPin}}
{{Map|name=Dwarven Mine|3060,3377|3019,3340|caption=The Falador entrances to the Dwarven Mine|align=left|mtype=pin|icon=redPin}}
*South gate: Entrance to the [[Mining Guild]], level 60 [[Mining]] required. Using a [[skills necklace]] to teleport directly to the Mining Guild is the quickest way to get here.
*Alternatively, [[Lassar Teleport]] to the top of the [[Ice Mountain]], then run south down to the main entrance.
*Falador entrance: A building in the far north-east of Falador has stairs down to the south end of the mine. A [[Falador Teleport]] is a fast way to get here and to get to the next entrance.
*Main entrance: In the foothills of the [[Ice Mountain]], north of the [[Falador]]-to-[[Barbarian Village]] road. Using a [[combat bracelet]] to [[Teleportation|teleport]] to the [[Edgeville Monastery]] is a quick way to get to this [[trapdoor (Dwarven Mine)|entrance]]. Another option is to use the [[Skull sceptre]]/[[Skull sceptre (i)]] to teleport to Barbarian village and walk north-west towards [[Ice Mountain]].
*Mine cart: [[Members]] may use the [[Keldagrim mine cart system]], to enter the mine in the north-west section. This two-way network allows players to travel between the Dwarven Mine and the bustling dwarven capital of [[Keldagrim]]. From the cart station in Keldagrim it is also possible to travel to [[White Wolf Mountain]] and the [[Grand Exchange]], provided that the [[Fishing Contest]] [[Quests|quest]] has been completed. One fast way to get to the mine is to take the carts from the Grand Exchange to Keldagrim and then to Ice Mountain.
{{clear|left}}

==Shops==
There are several [[shop]]s in the Dwarven Mine.
*[[Nurmof's Pickaxe Shop]] - which sells all types of [[pickaxe]]s from [[Bronze pickaxe|bronze]] to [[Rune pickaxe|rune]].
*[[Drogo's Mining Emporium]] - which sells [[Mining#Mineable items|ores]], pickaxes, [[hammer]]s and [[bar]]s.
*[[Crossbow Shop (Dwarven Mine)|Hura's Crossbow Shop]], which sells [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbow]]s, [[Crossbow limbs|limbs]], and [[Crossbow stock|stocks]]. It is available to members only.
*A [[Dwarven Shopping Store|general store]], run by a dwarf near the carts.

==Rocks==
Low levelled rocks, such as [[copper rocks|copper]], [[clay rocks|clay]], and [[tin rocks]] are all located south of the main entrance (from the [[Ice Mountain]]).

The higher level rocks, such as [[Coal rocks|coal]], [[gold rocks|gold]], [[adamantite rocks|adamantite]], and [[mithril rocks]] are near the [[Mining Guild]]. 2 gold rocks are located to the east of the Mining Guild. 5 coal rocks may be found there also. A bit to the north-west, there are 3 adamantite rocks, 2 mithril rocks, 3 [[iron rocks]], and 3 coal rocks. To the east, there is the [[Falador]] entrance. Further north, there are iron, tin, copper and 3 coal rocks.

==Other features==
*A [[bronze chainbody]], a [[pie dish]], and two [[coins]] [[Spawning|spawn]] in various places in the mine and thus can be taken for free.
*The chests near [[Hura]] are an objective of a [[Treasure Trails]] [[clue scroll]].
*An [[anvil]] in the northern section can be used while using [[Superheat Item]] on ores mined nearby.
*The [[disk of returning]] can be activated while in the mine to access the [[blackhole]].

==Trivia==
*Fires cannot be lit near the Dwarven Mine. Attempting to do so will yield the message "The dwarves won't be happy if you light a fire here". The area of this restriction extends as far out as the [[Edgeville Monastery]].
